sources.name: AMC / AMC Networks
sources.notes: Primary official source for series and episode metadata/media where publicly accessible.

sources.name: Walking Dead Wiki
sources.notes: High-value structured secondary source. TV Universe categories must be isolated from comic/game/non-canon continuity.

sources.name: The Walking Dead API
sources.notes: Verified via `npm run enrich:probe` (data/enrichment/source-health.json): the root, /api, /characters and /swagger paths all 404 on a free-tier Render host. Not usable for ingestion; keep the record for provenance but do not re-probe on a schedule.

sources.name: API-TWD-Characters
sources.notes: Identified as a small unhosted student-project repository (no public base URL, no deployment), not a running API — this session's GitHub access is scoped to this repo only, so its contents couldn't be inspected further. Nothing to ingest without cloning and running someone else's unmaintained service ourselves, which is out of proportion to what it would add over the Fandom wiki API already in use. Not pursued further; revisit only if a live, documented endpoint surfaces.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.notes: Use for entity reconciliation and external identifiers, not as the primary TWDU canon source.
